segments.name: Breast Aesthetics and Reconstruction
segments.description: Global medical technology company focused on silicone gel-filled breast implants for aesthetic augmentation and surgical reconstruction.
segments.evidence: Our line of silicone gel-filled breast implants, branded as Motiva Implants, is the centerpiece of our medical technology platform.

revenueModel.text: Medical device manufacturer sells breast implants and tissue expanders to patients through surgeons via distributors or direct sales.
revenueModel.evidence: Since launching Motiva Implants in October 2010, the majority of our revenue has been generated from sales of our Motiva Implants.

changes.text: In 2025, launched Preservé, a minimally invasive breast tissue-preserving technology, expanding product portfolio.
changes.evidence: In February 2025, we launched Preservé, a minimally invasive breast tissue-preserving technology for breast augmentation, revision augmentation and mastopexy augmentation.
